quote: Hilbert's twelfth problem was posed in 1900 as part of his famous list of 23 mathematical problems presented at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Paris
note: The problem was presented as part of Hilbert's 23 Problems lecture 'Mathematische Probleme' delivered on August 8, 1900 at the International Congress of Mathematicians in Paris, though the complete list was published in the proceedings
